extensionDescription.message: Makes the Fastmail web UI easier to use and more productive.

altSearchDesc.message: Search anywhere, in subject and body, or in subject only.

shortcutKeysDesc.message: Enter, Ctrl + Shift + L / M / I and more (see Keys).

layoutButton.message: Show a reading pane layout button

layoutButtonDesc.message: Side, Bottom or Off; saved to your Fastmail account.

cursorKeysDesc.message: Move in the list and between list and conversation.

hlKeysDesc.message: Replaces Fastmail's own H and L.

fastmailShortcutsOn.message: Turn off Fastmail's keyboard shortcuts to use this. Until then, J/K/N/P/E/Enter work as in Fastmail.

liveHint.message: Changes take effect in open Fastmail tabs at once.

keysWithLayout.message: With “Show a reading pane layout button”

keyUpDown.message: Move in the list, or between messages

keyLeftRight.message: Switch between the list and the conversation; open or close a message

keyHL.message: Same as ← →, with “Use H/L keys like ←/→”

keyEnter.message: Open or close the focused message

keyRightPanel.message: Show or hide the right panel

keyTextSize.message: Message text size: larger, smaller, reset

keyButtons.message: Show or hide the reading pane buttons
